description: Create the Three.js components (Hero.tsx and Gallery3D.tsx) and the Lightbox.tsx modal. These are the most complex pieces. They depend on FEAT-001's data/showcase.ts and the CSS variables added in FEAT-001. Hero and Gallery3D are 'use client' components loaded via next/dynamic with ssr:false from their parent. Lightbox uses Framer Motion AnimatePresence + layoutId shared transition.
steps: Create d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\components\showcase\Hero.tsx. 'use client'. This is the inner component rendered inside the Canvas — do NOT export a Canvas here. Exports a named HeroScene (the R3F scene graph) and a default HeroWrapper that wraps it in Canvas with ssr:false dynamic import handled by the parent. CORRECTION: Hero.tsx exports default HeroWrapper which renders a <Canvas> directly (the dynamic import with ssr:false is done in app/showcase/page.tsx when consuming it). Scene: floating screenshot planes using useTexture — pass encoded paths: encodeURIComponent on each filename segment only (the spaces), joined with '/' prefix. Plane geometry 16/9 aspect. Planes slowly orbit on a circular path using useFrame, Y-axis tilt. Particle background: 500 Points geometry (Float32Array positions), BufferAttribute, PointsMaterial with size=0.03, color=#6366f1. Performance: dpr={[1,2]}, gl={{ antialias: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }}, frameloop starts as 'demand', switch to 'always' on mount, switch back to 'demand' via IntersectionObserver in useEffect. On mobile (window.innerWidth < 768) reduce particle count to 150 and skip planes. prefers-reduced-motion: if matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches, freeze useFrame (use a ref flag). Lights: one AmbientLight intensity=0.6, one DirectionalLight intensity=0.8 position=[5,5,5]. Use import { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber' and import { useTexture, Float } from '@react-three/drei'. Suspense wraps the scene inside Canvas. Loading fallback: <Html center> (from @react-three/drei) with a spinner div.

Create d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\components\showcase\Gallery3D.tsx. 'use client'. Exports default. This component renders a full Canvas-based 3D gallery. Props: items: ShowcaseItem[]. Image paths encoded same as Hero (encodeURIComponent on each filename segment). Each item renders as a textured plane mesh. Arrange up to 8 items in a curved arc (position on arc: x = sin(i/n * Math.PI * 1.5 - Math.PI * 0.75) * 4, z = cos(i/n * Math.PI * 1.5 - Math.PI * 0.75) * 4, y = 0). OrbitControls from @react-three/drei with enableZoom=false, enablePan=false, minPolarAngle=Math.PI/3, maxPolarAngle=Math.PI/2 to prevent scroll hijacking. On hover/tap: scale 1→1.15 via useSpring (react-spring via @react-three/drei's animated), emit onSelect(item). Selected plane gets a glowing outline: meshStandardMaterial emissive color matches group accent. WebGL unavailable → show WebGLFallback (import from WebGLFallback.tsx). Pause rendering off-screen: useEffect with IntersectionObserver on the container div; set a renderRef, inside useFrame check renderRef before updating. Canvas props: dpr={[1,2]}, camera={{ position: [0,0,6], fov:50 }}, gl={{ antialias: false }}. Mobile: reduce to 5 items, larger touch targets (plane scale *1.3). Keyboard: pass onSelect up; parent (showcase page) handles focus. Show title + description overlay below canvas when item is selected (plain HTML outside Canvas, driven by selectedItem state).

Create d:\My-Projects\NEXT\hariswork\components\showcase\Lightbox.tsx. 'use client'. Props: items: ShowcaseItem['images'] (flat array of all images for the active item); initialIndex: number; onClose: () => void. Uses AnimatePresence + motion.div with layoutId='lightbox-{src}' shared transition (key = image src). Renders a fixed overlay (z-50, bg-black/90, backdrop-blur). Current image: next/image with fill, sizes='100vw', placeholder='blur', blurDataURL=BLUR_DATA_URL. Prev/next arrows: button elements, min 44px, aria-label='Previous image' / 'Next image'. Swipe support: useEffect with touchstart/touchend listeners on the overlay div, swipe distance > 50px triggers prev/next. Keyboard: useEffect adds keydown listener — ArrowLeft/ArrowRight for nav, Escape calls onClose. Focus management: useEffect auto-focuses the overlay div on mount (divRef.current?.focus()), restores focus to trigger element on close (accept triggerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement> prop). Caption: item title + description rendered below image. Esc button top-right. Respects prefers-reduced-motion: if reduce, use opacity-only transition (no scale/y shift).
acceptance_criteria: Hero.tsx renders a Canvas with floating planes and particle background — no SSR errors
Gallery3D.tsx renders a Canvas with curved arc of image planes — OrbitControls do not trap vertical scroll
Lightbox.tsx opens/closes with AnimatePresence, keyboard nav works (Arrow keys + Esc), swipe works on mobile
useTexture paths use encodeURIComponent on filename segments with spaces
All Three.js Canvases wrapped with next/dynamic ssr:false at call site (in app/showcase/page.tsx)

Hero.tsx: 'use client', exports HeroWrapper (Canvas + Suspense + HeroScene with floating screenshot planes via useTexture + 500-particle system), IntersectionObserver pauses rendering off-screen, prefers-reduced-motion gated via useRef+useEffect, dpr=[1,2], frameloop='always', mobile reduces to 150 particles and skips planes. Gallery3D.tsx: 'use client', exports Gallery3DWrapper, OrbitControls with enableZoom=false/enablePan=false/polar angle constraints to prevent scroll hijacking, curved arc arrangement (8 items max, 5 on mobile), useWebGL() hook for WebGL fallback, frameloop='demand', selectedItem overlay outside Canvas using AnimatePresence.
